optimized_sql:
WITH filtered_title AS (
    SELECT t.id, t.title
    FROM title AS t
    WHERE t.production_year > 2000
      AND (t.title LIKE '%Freddy%' OR t.title LIKE '%Jason%' OR t.title LIKE 'Saw%')
),
liongate_bluray AS (
    SELECT mc.movie_id
    FROM movie_companies AS mc
    JOIN company_name AS cn ON cn.id = mc.company_id
    WHERE mc.note LIKE '%(Blu-ray)%'
      AND cn.name LIKE 'Lionsgate%'
)
SELECT MIN(mi.info) AS movie_budget,
       MIN(mi_idx.info) AS movie_votes,
       MIN(n.name) AS writer,
       MIN(ft.title) AS violent_liongate_movie
FROM filtered_title AS ft
JOIN liongate_bluray AS lb ON lb.movie_id = ft.id
JOIN movie_info AS mi ON mi.movie_id = ft.id
JOIN info_type AS it1 ON it1.id = mi.info_type_id
JOIN movie_info_idx AS mi_idx ON mi_idx.movie_id = ft.id
JOIN info_type AS it2 ON it2.id = mi_idx.info_type_id
JOIN cast_info AS ci ON ci.movie_id = ft.id
JOIN name AS n ON n.id = ci.person_id
JOIN movie_keyword AS mk ON mk.movie_id = ft.id
JOIN keyword AS k ON k.id = mk.keyword_id
WHERE it1.info = 'genres'
  AND mi.info IN ('Horror', 'Thriller')
  AND it2.info = 'votes'
  AND ci.note IN ('(writer)', '(head writer)', '(written by)', '(story)', '(story editor)')
  AND n.gender = 'm'
  AND k.keyword IN ('murder', 'violence', 'blood', 'gore', 'death', 'female-nudity', 'hospital')
